description: This file manages MLD (Multicast Listener Discovery) configuration for access points, including applying configurations to linked access points, handling configuration changes, and integrating with a device management system.

methods.name: set_ap_mldConfig
methods.description: Applies current MLD configuration to all linked access points, updating their settings and pushing changes to firmware.

methods.name: s_setApMldConfig_ocf
methods.description: Handles changes in MLD configuration parameters, updates internal config, and applies new settings to linked access points.

methods.name: _wld_ap_setMLDConfig_ocf
methods.description: Triggers the MLD configuration change handler in the device management system.
